content:
Elena Park: quick q for folks — partner team (AWS Marketplace) is asking if we can bundle a customer story with the marketplace launch comms. They want a “proof point” asset (case study or at least customer quote) live the same week. Is that realistic given our case study program timeline?

Ben Carter: depends which customer + how “public” we can go. If it’s just a logo + 1 quote + short web story, maybe. If it’s full PDF + architecture diagram + metrics, that’s the long pole.

Camila Reyes: +1. partner launch moment could be a great accelerant but only if we don’t create a last-minute legal / security fire drill.

Soojin Lee: do we know which marketplace + target date? and are they expecting co-branded blog post, or just “listed on marketplace” + customer outcomes?

Elena Park: AWS Marketplace listing. Target week is Dec 9 (their “partner spotlight” slot). Requirements from AWS: 1) customer quote (named spokesperson + title), 2) approval to use logo, 3) a short success story page they can link to. Optional: joint webinar in Jan.

Tyler Benson: from ops side: if we do this, we need a clean approval path + a single source of truth for status. otherwise we’ll have 7 versions floating around email.

Ben Carter: which customer are you thinking? NovaDocs seems easiest for public architecture + cost story. Arcadia is super sensitive (VPC/private + security). QuantaPay might work but they’ll lawyer everything.

Elena Park: partner team suggested QuantaPay since they’re also on AWS and have a “real prod” angle. But I’m open — just need something credible.

Camila Reyes: if QuantaPay: we should assume 2+ rounds of redlines on claims language. Also need to be careful with any “% latency improvement” unless we can cite measurement window + baseline assumptions.

Soojin Lee: if the partner ask is “customer story page they can link to”, we can do a lighter format:
- headline + 2–3 paragraphs
- 3 bullets: outcomes (latency / cost / reliability)
- small architecture diagram *only if customer ok*
- quote block
But we still need legal release + metrics validation.

Avery Johnson: fwiw QuantaPay’s champion is pro-marketing, but procurement/legal is strict. In sales cycles they’ve asked for exact wording + scope of logo usage.

Michael Grant: jumping in — if this is tied to marketplace promotion, partner may treat it like “press” even if it’s just a web page. That means we need:
1) signed quote/logo release (with scope: web, PDF, partner channels)
2) final customer approval of *exact* quote and any metrics
3) internal security review for architecture details (what we disclose)
If we want this week-of-Dec-9, we need customer redline cycle started no later than ~Nov 18.

Sofia Mendes: +1 to Michael. also note: if QuantaPay’s MSA has marketing restrictions / NDA clauses, we may need an amendment or explicit carve-out. That can add time.

Tessa Morgan: design constraints: if AWS wants a “success story” we can ship a simple web page fast. PDF layout + custom diagrams are what eat time. If we keep it to a templated page (new case study template), I can turn around design in ~3–4 biz days after copy is final.

Ben Carter: proposal: treat marketplace bundle as “minimum viable co-marketing”
- publish short case study page (web)
- optionally a 1-page PDF export (same content)
- no deep architecture diagram unless approved early
- focus on 1–2 metrics max, with caveats

Camila Reyes: ok but we need to pick the customer *this week* so marketing can align interviews + validation. also — partner approvals can be slow. Elena, do you know AWS review SLA?

Elena Park: AWS partner marketing review SLA is “10 business days” once they have final assets (quote + logo + link). they also require their own legal to sign off if we mention AWS by name in the story.

Soojin Lee: so backwards plan:
- Nov 12: choose customer + confirm willingness (public)
- Nov 15: interview(s) complete
- Nov 20: copy draft v1 ready
- Nov 22: internal review (claims/security/legal)
- Nov 25: send to customer for redlines
- Dec 2: final customer sign-off + release form executed
- Dec 3–5: publish page + hand link/asset to AWS
That’s tight but doable if no surprises.

Tyler Benson: I can set up a tracker row for “Marketplace bundle” with explicit gates: draft complete → internal approved → customer review → release signed → published → partner delivered. Owners per gate.

Jordan Blake: from CRO perspective, I like tying the marketplace moment to a real customer outcome, but only if we can guarantee accuracy. No “hand-wavy 50% faster” stuff. If QuantaPay is high-risk for delays, NovaDocs might be smarter even if it’s less ‘enterprise’.

Avery Johnson: NovaDocs will probably say yes faster. They’ve already asked about doing a public architecture diagram + blog.

Elena Park: ok, I’ll ask AWS if NovaDocs still works for their slot (they initially said QuantaPay but didn’t sound mandatory). I’ll also DM Avery re: getting a quick “are you willing to be public + quote/logo by Dec 2” commitment from NovaDocs.

Michael Grant: please loop legal in *before* sending any new release form language to the customer. use the standard template + we’ll adjust scope if AWS needs it.

Camila Reyes: action items:
- Elena: confirm with AWS if customer must be QuantaPay vs any production customer; get exact asset checklist + review SLA in writing
- Avery: soft-signal NovaDocs on timeline + identify spokesperson
- Soojin + Ben: draft “marketplace-friendly” story outline (short form)
- Tyler: create tracker + gate checklist

CloudMarketplaceBot: Reminder set by Elena Park for Nov 12: “Confirm customer + timeline for marketplace bundle (AWS)”
